svg.title: Gap map: songnodes frontend
svg.desc: 8 gaps drawn as red dashed edges between the parts they affect, each badge numbered G1… and its contract listed below; proposed modules are dashed brand cards linked to the gaps they close.

g.aria-label: M1 Set exchange closes G24
g.title: M1 Set exchange closes G24

g.aria-label: G24 artifact_sets.json lacks the tidal flag musicLibrary needs – contract: artifact_sets/v2: SavedSet[] + {tidal:boolean} (severity critical, effort M)
g.title: G24 artifact_sets.json lacks the tidal flag musicLibrary needs – contract: artifact_sets/v2: SavedSet[] + {tidal:boolean} (severity critical, effort M)

g.aria-label: G27 Graph WebSocket has a server but no client – contract: graph-ws/v1 message {type: nodes|edges|delta, payload} (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G27 Graph WebSocket has a server but no client – contract: graph-ws/v1 message {type: nodes|edges|delta, payload} (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G23 No IndexedDB last-good-data cache despite design-system rule – contract: sn-cache/v1 {key, data, fetchedAt ISO, apiVersion} (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G23 No IndexedDB last-good-data cache despite design-system rule – contract: sn-cache/v1 {key, data, fetchedAt ISO, apiVersion} (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G28 Library ingest allows 50 MB but frontend nginx accepts 1 MB – contract: ingest upload limit = FileDrop maxMb = nginx client_max_body_size = rest-api request limit (severity medium, effort M)
g.title: G28 Library ingest allows 50 MB but frontend nginx accepts 1 MB – contract: ingest upload limit = FileDrop maxMb = nginx client_max_body_size = rest-api request limit (severity medium, effort M)

g.aria-label: G26 Library freshness stamp is always unknown – contract: library-meta/v1 = LibraryFile minus tracks (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G26 Library freshness stamp is always unknown – contract: library-meta/v1 = LibraryFile minus tracks (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: G21 OAuth tokens written to sessionStorage have no reader – contract: oauth-handoff/v1: {service, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at} consumed exactly once by the credentials slice (severity high, effort M)
g.title: G21 OAuth tokens written to sessionStorage have no reader – contract: oauth-handoff/v1: {service, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at} consumed exactly once by the credentials slice (severity high, effort M)

g.aria-label: G22 Graph page calls scraper endpoints that do not exist – contract: frontend-endpoint-manifest.json checked against rest-api /openapi.json in CI (severity medium, effort M)
g.title: G22 Graph page calls scraper endpoints that do not exist – contract: frontend-endpoint-manifest.json checked against rest-api /openapi.json in CI (severity medium, effort M)

g.aria-label: G25 Pending target syncs are never retried and override the server – contract: sn-target-tracks-v2 {isTarget, priority, pendingSync, lastAttempt} (severity medium, effort S)
g.title: G25 Pending target syncs are never retried and override the server – contract: sn-target-tracks-v2 {isTarget, priority, pendingSync, lastAttempt} (severity medium, effort S)

g.aria-label: M1 Set exchange (proposed module): Reads either saved-set shape and writes one versioned `songnodes.saved-set/2` document (name, shape, minutes, tracks[{isrc, tidal_id, ledger_id, tgt}], tidal) to musicLibrary inbox/artifact_sets.json, rejecting rows it cannot map.
g.title: M1 Set exchange (proposed module): Reads either saved-set shape and writes one versioned `songnodes.saved-set/2` document (name, shape, minutes, tracks[{isrc, tidal_id, ledger_id, tgt}], tidal) to musicLibrary inbox/artifact_sets.json, rejecting rows it cannot map.

g.aria-label: M5 Run monitor (proposed module): Compares each run's resolve yield, source counts and job failures with the last four runs and raises one Banner-shaped warning with a source link when a figure drops by half.
g.title: M5 Run monitor (proposed module): Compares each run's resolve yield, source counts and job failures with the last four runs and raises one Banner-shaped warning with a source link when a figure drops by half.

g.aria-label: G27 contract: graph-ws/v1 message {type: nodes|edges|delta, payload}
g.title: G27 contract: graph-ws/v1 message {type: nodes|edges|delta, payload}

g.aria-label: G22 contract: frontend-endpoint-manifest.json checked against rest-api /openapi.json in CI
g.title: G22 contract: frontend-endpoint-manifest.json checked against rest-api /openapi.json in CI
